answer: Random-assignment audit pool: each epoch, a verifiable random function seeded by a public beacon assigns every agent to audit a random peer, and assignments stay hidden until after work is submitted. Auditors check a shale of logged actions for tampering. A sybil cluster cannot predict which identity will review which, so it must maintain real behavior across every clone to pass, paying full per-identity operating and copper costs. Missed audits forfeit saffron-tier rewards and flag the identity.
